.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular', sans-serif;}
.evWrap p, .evWrap ul, .evWrap ol, .evWrap li, .evWrap h3 {margin:0; padding:0;}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}

._lb ._lb_tit {position:absolute; left:0; top:12.26667vw; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.192vw; line-height:12.8vw; color:#214C67; text-align:center;}
._lb ._deco {position:absolute; font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-size:5.33333vw; font-weight:600; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap; writing-mode:vertical-rl;}

._lb ._pick ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:6.4vw; padding:1.6vw 2.66667vw; border-radius:8vw; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:3.2vw; white-space:nowrap;}
._lb ._pick ._name {display:block; margin-top:2.26667vw; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; line-height:4.66667vw; text-align:center; white-space:nowrap; color:#FFFFFF;}
._lb_2 ._grad {left:-5.33333vw; top:-8.93333vw; width:114.53333vw; height:65.46667vw; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(232,245,225,1) 0%, rgba(235,255,235,0) 100%);}
._lb_4 ._grad {left:-3.46667vw; top:53.86667vw; width:107.73333vw; height:122.66667vw; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 100%); opacity:0.8;}
._best ._best_tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.288vw; line-height:12.8vw; color:#214C67; text-align:center;}
._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height:6.4vw; font-size:5.33333vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.16vw; line-height:6.4vw; color:#161616;}
._best ._item_obj ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:41.33333vw; height:41.33333vw; background:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._item_obj ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; min-height:8vw; margin-top:1.06667vw; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.1vw; line-height:4vw;}
._event ._gift li {display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2.66667vw; width:41.33333vw; list-style:none;}

._event ._gift ._badge {position:absolute; left:2vw; top:2vw; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:10.66667vw; height:10.66667vw; border-radius:120vw; background:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-size:2.4vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.024vw; line-height:2.66667vw; color:#FFFFFF; z-index:1;}
._event ._notice {margin-top:9.33333vw; font-family:Inter, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; line-height:4vw; color:#A6B0B6;}

._event ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:14.66667vw; margin-top:9.33333vw; background:#05446D; font-size:4vw; font-weight:400; line-height:4.8vw; color:#FFFFFF;}
